entry_points.name: delete_account
entry_points.note: Route function that loads the user row by id and deletes it in one session.

stores.name: users

erasure.note: The route calls session.delete on the User row and commits; no other model holds a foreign key to it.

stores.note: SQLAlchemy table holding one row per account.

stores.name: sessions:

fields.name: email
fields.note: The Redis key is built as sessions: followed by the account email address.

fields.name: token
fields.note: The session token is the value stored under that key.

erasure.note: purge_session deletes the key but no module calls it; the delete_account route touches only the database session.

stores.note: Redis namespace holding a login token per account email.

stores.name: stripe

fields.name: name
fields.note: The account full_name is sent as the customer name.

erasure.note: The repository creates Stripe customers and contains no Stripe deletion call.

stores.note: Stripe customer records created at signup.

stores.name: mixpanel

fields.name: email
fields.note: The account email address is passed as the Mixpanel distinct id.

fields.name: account_created
fields.note: Event name recorded against that email address.

erasure.note: The repository sends events to Mixpanel and contains no Mixpanel deletion call.

stores.note: Product analytics events sent at signup.

stores.name: sendgrid

fields.name: full_name
fields.note: The account full_name is interpolated into the message body.

erasure.note: The repository sends mail through SendGrid and contains no call to remove recipients there.

stores.note: Transactional welcome mail sent at signup.

stores.name: sentry

fields.name: url
fields.note: Listed in SENTRY_DEFAULT_FIELDS as sent by default.

fields.name: query_string
fields.note: Listed in SENTRY_DEFAULT_FIELDS as sent by default.

fields.name: request_body
fields.note: Listed in SENTRY_DEFAULT_FIELDS as sent by default; the schema does not constrain its contents.

fields.name: local_variables
fields.note: Stack-frame locals listed in SENTRY_DEFAULT_FIELDS as sent by default.

erasure.note: Sentry is initialised at import time in app.py and the repository contains no call to delete events there.

stores.note: Error tracker initialised when the application module is imported.

retention.criteria: Redis key expires after SESSION_TTL_SECONDS, set to 86400 seconds.
